name: llm-chat
title: LLM Chat
description: Chat with mainstream Chinese LLMs (GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, Doubao, DeepSeek). Multi-turn conversations, LaTeX math rendering, and collapsible thinking process.
author: caleb

commands.name: chat
commands.title: LLM Chat
commands.description: Start a multi-turn chat with your configured LLM provider

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your API key for the selected provider

preferences.name: customBaseUrl
preferences.title: Custom Base URL
preferences.description: Base URL for custom model endpoint (only for Custom provider)

preferences.name: thinkingEnabled
preferences.title: Enable Thinking Mode
preferences.label: Enable Thinking Mode
preferences.description: Enable thinking/reasoning mode with visible reasoning output

preferences.name: defaultHideThinking
preferences.title: Default to Hide Thinking
preferences.label: Default to Hide Thinking
preferences.description: Hide the final displayed thinking process by default

preferences.name: defaultRenderLatexMath
preferences.title: Default to Render Latex Math
preferences.label: Default to Render Latex Math
preferences.description: Render LaTeX math in the final display by default

preferences.name: temperature
preferences.title: Temperature
preferences.description: Controls randomness (0.0-2.0, leave empty for provider default)

preferences.name: maxTokens
preferences.title: Max Tokens
preferences.description: Maximum output tokens (leave empty for provider default)
